title: Senior UI/UX Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  

  

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------


**ROLE PURPOSE**


Design the experience layer that makes the new cloud environment feel better than what it replaces. The role turns migration into adoption: intuitive dashboards, intake forms, templates, navigation, and visual standards that reduce friction for 10,000 users — especially the non\-technical majority encountering Jira and Confluence in new ways.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design and build standardized, role\-relevant Jira dashboards, boards, and reporting views for key personas (leadership, PMO, agile teams, corporate functions), aligned to SAFe artifacts where applicable.
* Design intake forms, request types, and guided workflows that make Jira approachable as a lightweight task and intake tool for non\-technical teams.
* Define Confluence information architecture and template systems: space structures, navigation patterns, page templates for common needs (retrospectives, decision logs, playbooks, meeting notes).
* Establish and document experience standards — naming, layout, visual consistency — so team\-created content converges rather than fragments after migration.
* Partner with the Training Lead and OCM Lead on the visual quality of enablement assets: guides, video walkthroughs, communications templates, and champion toolkits.
* Run lightweight usability feedback loops after each wave; translate friction findings into concrete configuration and template improvements.
* Prototype experience enhancements using platform\-native capabilities (Jira/Confluence configuration, automation, and — where appropriate — Forge UI patterns) in consultation with the Jira Cloud Architect.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

* 7\+ years in UI/UX design/engineering with a portfolio demonstrating enterprise platform or workflow\-tool experience design (not solely marketing or consumer surfaces).
* Hands\-on Jira and Confluence configuration depth: dashboards, filters, boards, templates, space design — enough to build, not just specify.
* Strong information\-architecture and design\-system craft; ability to codify standards other teams can follow.
* Working front\-end proficiency (HTML/CSS/JavaScript) for prototyping and asset production.
* User\-research instincts: comfortable running feedback sessions and converting findings into prioritized improvements.

**PREFERRED**

* Experience designing for mixed technical/non\-technical enterprise audiences during a platform change.
* Familiarity with Atlassian Forge UI kit or Marketplace app UX patterns.
* Data\-visualization craft for programme and adoption reporting surfaces.
